component.name: Universal Linux Install & Uninstall Center
component.summary: Install and remove Linux software packages

description.p: Manage Flatpak, AppImage, RPM, DEB, Arch and Snap packages using one graphical interface. Available actions depend on the package manager installed on the host distribution.
Beheer Flatpak-, AppImage-, RPM-, DEB-, Arch- en Snap-pakketten via één grafische interface. Beschikbare functies zijn afhankelijk van de Linux-distributie.
Initial public release candidate with package management, guarded uninstall actions and feedback support.
